argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: Modus tollens against Marquis's FLO account

distinctions_drawn: future-like-ours vs. future owned by a subject
deprivation of possibilities vs. violation of rights

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: rejects potential-only moral status; argues it collapses distinctions between hermit/comatose and conscious adult
objections_raised: potential alone sufficient for moral status

philosophical_orientation.thematic_focus: moral status, personal identity, rights, abortion

structural_organization.structure_type: dialectical progression from thesis to objections to synthesis to application

summary_of_core_decisions: The text resolves the dialectic by requiring an actualized subject to own unrealized possibilities; abortion is not an immoral loss because the fetus lacks actualized psychological continuity, consciousness, and rights.
